statement: The Empire of Trebizond — the last surviving Byzantine successor state, ruled by the Komnenos dynasty since 1204 — was conquered by Mehmed II in August 1461, eight years after Constantinople. Mehmed blockaded the harbor while his army advanced through the Pontic Alps. Emperor David Komnenos surrendered after a month; he was later executed despite promises of safety. Mehmed II claimed the title 'Caesar of Rome' after both conquests, completing the elimination of all Greek Christian imperial states.
